pages.title: Habitat
pages.text: Star Brambles generate sparsely on S-grade paradise planets and can only grow and mature there. Planets added by datapacks, planets in the starting galaxy, and ring world segments do not count as naturally generated S-grade planets.

pages.title: Harvest
pages.text: On S-grade paradise planets, Star Brambles periodically mature and can be harvested for Starbulbs. Starbulbs can be used to craft valuable items.

pages.title: Withering
pages.text: On planets without an S-grade paradise rating, Star Brambles do not mature and quickly turn into withered brambles.
